pages.text: [#](53341a)The old book also indexed cauldron cooking, Nether Wart, End Stone, Rotten Flesh, and a Player Compass. Those old transmutations are **not accepted by the present cauldron**.[#]()
pages.title: The Older Index

pages.text: [#](53341a)They remain part of the source record, but this guide will not pretend an unavailable working can be performed.[#]() [#](53341a)The Player Compass has a modern crafting recipe and can also be bound with a filled player Taglock Kit.[#]()
[#](53341a)Chalk, Mutandis, Mutandis Extremis, Drop of Luck, and the Mutating Sprig also keep ordinary recipe bridges for accessibility.[#]()
[#](53341a)Craft the blank compass, then bind it directly to a player or combine it with that player's filled Taglock Kit.[#]()
pages.title: Player Compass
